title: Gliomas phenocopy an inborn error of metabolism to drive neuronal activity and tumor growth.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: GEO (Gene Expression Omnibus) metadata via NCBI E-utilities for the text-mined series: the paper's own GSE343542 has 64 RNA-seq samples (TXT processed files) and GSE343207 has 22 genome-binding samples (BigWig/peak files); the other GEO IDs belong to earlier papers (39, 3 and 121 samples). Europe PMC full text returned HTTP 500 and the supplement listing was not retrievable.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Abstract only: human brain-tissue metabolomics showing ~100-fold guanidinoacetate (GAA) accumulation in high-grade glioma, plus mechanistic neuron-glioma experiments. No deposited metabolomics table was found; sample counts for tissue metabolomics are unknown.

a1_downloadable.note: GEO series are public; processed TXT/BW files listed in metadata, not opened. Metabolomics data location unknown (full text and supplement unretrievable).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No outcome table exists; the RNA-seq is perturbation experiments (e.g. enzyme knockdown vs control) whose 'label' is the experimental condition, not a measured outcome to predict. Checked GEO metadata only.

a3_inputs_present.note: Processed expression files are listed in GEO; not opened.

a5_enough_rows.note: Paper's own deposits total 64 RNA-seq plus 22 binding-profile samples per GEO metadata, far under 400 even for classification.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Could not compare: full text unavailable.

a8_label_provenance.note: Conditions are experimental design, not model outputs.

honest_claim_h3: With 64 perturbation RNA-seq samples, no model claim is supportable; this is a mechanistic biology paper.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use tumor gene expression to predict guanidinoacetate buildup in high-grade brain tumors.
plain_idea.train_on: Bulk RNA-seq profiles from glioma cells under experimental perturbations; 64 samples per GEO metadata.
plain_idea.predict: Metabolite (GAA) level or perturbation condition; GAA was measured by tissue metabolomics whose data was not found deposited.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Could flag which gliomas over-produce GAA for a candidate metabolic therapy, but the data are far too few and not paired.

ml_idea: None viable: tiny mechanistic perturbation datasets with no outcome table.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: GEO sample count for the paper's own series (64 and 22) — done, kills it.

verdict_reason: Mechanistic paper; its own deposits are 64 RNA-seq and 22 binding-profile samples (GEO metadata), with no outcome column, so A2 and A5 fail.
